Name: Tech's Cross-Mod Bundles
Author: TechnicalityCreations
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Tech’s Cross-Mod Bundles seeks to make playing multiple content mods feel like a more cohesive experience by dynamically generating bundles based on what mods you have. Each[/color] bundle is hand designed, with focus on matching vanilla’s theming and balance. 

It also contains a [b]Completionist Mode[/b] which makes every bundle require every item, if you want more of a challenge.

[size=4][b]Supported Mods (None of these are required, but their content can all be included in the bundles)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Ridgeside Village[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]East Scarp[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Cornucopia (all of them)[/color][/*]
[*]Visit Mount Vapius[/*]
[*]Sunberry Village[/*]
[*]Mizu’s Animal Mods[/*]
[*]Downtown Zuzu[/*]
[*]Aquatic Sea Fish[/*]
[*]Alchemistry[/*]
[*]Chicken Feed[/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]DISABLE REMIXED BUNDLES[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]A NEW SAVE IS RECOMMENDED BUT EXISTING SAVES ALSO WORK IF YOU PREVIOUSLY USED VANILLA BUNDLES[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=3]If you use an existing save, you will keep all of your progress, as long as you weren't using any other bundle mods. [/size][/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Huge thanks to all of the many mod authors who gave me permission to implement their mod into bundles.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]No AI was used in the creation of this mod.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Please endorse this mod if you like it! It really means a lot to me to see people enjoying my mod, and it encourages me to make more stuff. Also leave any suggestions for mods to add in the comments.[/color]
